mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:strong labor markets boost consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of easing cycle instances with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 6-year rolling window during easing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as housing is a leading indicator of economic health.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL increases by > 0.5% in a single month, indicating potential inflationary pressures, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances with CPIAUCSL 1mo change > 0.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 4-year rolling window.

evidence_refs: fact:robust labor markets drive long-term growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in RSAFS, indicating heightened retail sales, boosts market sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but this effect is muted during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of non-tightening cycle instances with significant RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-year rolling window during non-tightening cycles.
